segments.text: The teachings of God are deeply affecting, and impressive teachings: they fully reach the heart of man, Hos. 2. 14. I will allure her, and bring her into the wilderness and speak comfortably unto her: or as it is in the Hebrew, I will speak to her heart. When God showeth unto man the evil of sin, he so convinceth the soul that no creature comforts have any pleasure or sweetness in them: and when he sheweth unto man his righteousness, pardon and peace in Christ, he so comforteth and refresheth the heart, that no outward afflictions have any weight or bitterness in them: one drop of consolation from Heaven, sweetens a Sea of trouble upon Earth, Psal. 94. 19. In the multitude of my thoughts within me, thy comforts delight my soul.
